summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Antonio Tosti, an Italian Catholic cardinal who lived from 4 October 1776 to 20 March 1866. It states that he served as Cardinal-Priest of San Pietro in Montorio in Rome, and later as Camerlengo of the Sacred College of Cardinals and Librarian of the Vatican Library. The note contains no further detail beyond these offices and dates.
one_line: Antonio Tosti (1776–1866) was a Catholic cardinal who held the titles of San Pietro in Montorio, Camerlengo, and Vatican Library Librarian.
key_facts: Antonio Tosti was born on 4 October 1776.
Antonio Tosti was a Catholic Cardinal-Priest of San Pietro in Montorio in Rome.
Antonio Tosti later served as Camerlengo of the Sacred College of Cardinals.
Antonio Tosti served as Librarian of the Vatican Library.
